about_p2: We work out of Linden and the towns around it.

services.title: Lawn care and mowing
services.body: Lawns are cut, edged and cleaned up on a schedule so the yard never gets ahead of you.

evidence.text: The front of the house with the beds planted and the lawn cut to the kerb

services.title: Mulch and bed work
services.body: Beds are cleaned out, edged and mulched, and plantings are set where they will actually grow.

evidence.text: A bed mulched black with the maple and the boulder set into it

services.title: Hardscape, patios and walkways
services.body: Base is compacted and screeded before a single paver or block goes down, which is why it stays level.
services.alt: A timber retaining wall built the length of the drive and backfilled

services.title: Sod, seeding and grading
services.body: The ground is graded and prepped first, then sodded or seeded so the new lawn takes instead of washing out.

evidence.text: Sam's did a great job with cleanup, grading and seeding my front and back yards.
evidence.also: Additionally his team put down grass seed and slowly but surely the grass is growing back.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Anne
reviews.text: Great job by Sam’s Landscaping! They put in a beautiful line of trees and privacy shrubs, did a thorough cleanup before and after and provided overall great service. Very personable and attentive from the first call. These days that rare! I recommend them and will use them again. Thanks!

reviews.author: Terry Lyp
reviews.text: Amazing work! Communication was super easy. Very easy to work with. Sam’s Landscaping moved an existing patio, added a sitting wall and built a new small patio as well. The whole experience was fantastic.

reviews.author: Paul Daly
reviews.text: From start to finish, it was a pleasure working with Sam’s. Everyone was pleasant & professional. The pricing was competitive & things moved along very quickly. The team that came to perform the work was very good. They worked quickly & carefully. I plan to use Sam’s going forward for all our landscaping!

reviews.author: Films by Diallo
reviews.text: Man!! Where do I start? I’ve tried calling countless of landscapers for this job, most either didn’t pick up the phone, and if they did, they weren’t on time, super expensive or just not professional. Sam picked up on the 2nd ring!! Came and gave me a quote the same day! And finished this job within 1 week!! Wow. To top it off for the price & quality I couldn’t get that anywhere else. They were professional!! They went above and beyond with doing things beyond what I paid for, his team members were respectful, and you can tell they really enjoy what they do. Super thankful to have found these guys I wish I had more backyard damage to work on to hire them again!! I can’t recommend sams Landscapping enough!! 10/10. Beautiful sod grass, and beautiful pavers, my kids and family can now enjoy going out in the back. Super happy!!

reviews.author: Audrey Farrow
reviews.text: These are before and after photos. I love it! In a time when it seems no one wants to work, Jim was very responsive. He responded to all calls and text messages. Started and completed the project when he said he would and even threw in some rhododendron and hydrangeas, my favorites! His team cleaned up afterwards for which I'm extremely grateful. His may be a small family landscaping business, but they are big on quality and service.

reviews.author: P Gill
reviews.text: We used Sam's for tree trimming. They did a great job trimming and cleaning up, all for a more than reasonable price. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Stephanie Grady
reviews.text: Sam’s landscaping did an amazing job transforming our backyard ! We love the paver patio that replaced a large concrete patio that was in the middle of the yard !

reviews.author: Angela S
reviews.text: Love love love! Jim and his crew at Sam’s Landscaping did an amazing job updating our patio. They removed an old gas grill, moved the gas line for a natural gas fire pit, removed old concrete slabs from the patio, and combined our old blue slate tiles with new blue slate tiles to create a larger patio. We couldn’t be happier with the results! Jim and his crew were beyond nice. They were professional and listened to all our concerns. They completed the job faster than anticipated and very thorough with the job. We will be using Sam’s Landscaping again for our future landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Barbara Gubernat
reviews.text: We hired Sam’s landscaping to remove a large shrub, put down fabric, and add rocks to our existing rocks. They did an amazing job and we could not be happier. Definitely recommend them and will continue to use them in the future.

reviews.author: Tayo Orekie
reviews.text: Jim and His crew were nice to work with. They did a professional job in a timely manner and they were very clean. We contacted him and within a month all things were completed with our front lawn. Looking forward to seeing how it all grows:). .

reviews.author: Tara Trapas
reviews.text: Sam’s does my regular maintenance and I’m always happy. Just this past week they removed a tree that was dying and I was very impressed with the handling of the job. Very respectful and clean up was immaculate which was great! Highly recommend

reviews.author: James Serpico
reviews.text: Sam's Landscaping just completed a Fall '21 refresh of my property and Jim's awesome team were professional, diligent and very comprehensive. The property looks amazing. Have owner Jim Santiago show you additional photos. Thanks for the hard work !

reviews.author: Carmen Rivera
reviews.text: We called Sam's Landscaping because we were having draining issues in the yard. During heavy rain storms, water would pool up then come towards the house and garage. After my call, Jim, showed up within 15 minutes to assess and provided a solution that was reasonable and an immediate quote. The job took about a day and a half and the people that came to help with the job were very professional and knowledgable. The yard is leveled and we already have grass growing in like a week! We are very pleased with the work!

reviews.author: Milena Pastorius
reviews.text: Jim and his team from Sam’s landscaping did a great job with your front steps replacing the limestone slabs and installing new hand rails. The work started within 1 week and was finished in a timely manner. Great communication and reasonable price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mark msgraw
reviews.text: Contacted Sam’s Landscaping at end of May for a quote on a stepping stone pathway. Jim was at my house within two days and agreed that a simple design would be suitable, but gave 2 quotes so final decision would be mine. Two workers were onsite 4 weeks to the day of the quote. Even though they were working during this stretch of high heat, they finished in 3 hours leaving my yard neat and in order. The pathway is simple but accents my yard and looks perfect! Great job!

reviews.author: Leila Cruz
reviews.text: Jim, the owner, responded immediately to my call for an estimate. He came by, walked our property gave recommendations and ideas. We needed a complete fall clean up. Property hadn't been maintained in awhile. His team of 3 started a few days later. They worked hard all day long and did a beautiful job.

reviews.author: Jessica Lynn Conte
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about Sam’s landscaping! I recently moved into a new home that had long neglected flower beds. It drove me crazy! I decided to go with Sam’s Landscaping after seeing so many great reviews. Not only was the communication amazing, but the team was super efficient, meticulous and fast. They took so much care in tending to my home, I was so happy! Highly recommend using Sam’s for any of your future lawn care needs! I will absolutely be hiring them again in the future. Thanks, Sam’s!!

reviews.author: Brad Heegel
reviews.text: Grateful for finding a post about Sam's on FB one day as we seriously needed help uncovering our property into which we'd moved in December. I contacted Sam's to see if they would be willing to do a "fall cleanup" for us and Jim got right back to me with a positive response. The team he sent were marvelous - really nice guys with incredible attention to detail and stamina! After two days of hard work (we don't think a clean up had been done for a few years) our property is the envy of the neighborhood and we can now can enjoy it the way we should. Thanks so much - I'll recommend you guys to the moon and back and look forward to working with you again.

reviews.author: Kristin Besanceney
reviews.text: Great experience! Jim responded quickly after my initial contact. Made great suggestions and was extremely accommodating to our needs. Work was scheduled promptly and completed on time and the job was done exceptionally well. Beautiful job! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Pattie
reviews.text: Just had my end of season clean up by Sam's Landscaping and it went very well! Jim was great, gave me a good price and everything was done to my satisfaction! I called 3 places to get prices for this job and Jim was the only one who made the effort to get me a price and complete the job. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Gianna Salermo
reviews.text: Sam's landscaping was great, they showed up on time, charged a fair price. Fixed my paver walkway, trimmed a lot on the property. Beautifully edged to beds and installed black mulch. Now I have the nicest house on the block!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: Jim and his crew did an exceptional job with our front and back yard. They were able to turn our vision into reality and keep it within our modest budget. Jim and his team went above and beyond and replanted some of our ornamental grass in another location, rather than getting rid of it; and also hauled away a pile of sticks we had behind the garage, without being asked. I’m super impressed with Jim and his team and the job that they did. We would hire them again and would certainly recommend them to our friends and neighbors.

reviews.author: Heather Severs
reviews.text: Did a spring clean up for us which included front and back lawns, bushes trimmed etc…nothing had been done in a couple years. These guys were meticulous! and the price beat all other quotes i got. well worth it! also was able to accommodate on short notice before Easter. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Robert Maver
reviews.text: Sam's did a great job with cleanup, grading and seeding my front and back yards. They also extended a paver patio.....all looks great! Jim is responsive and very easy to work with.

reviews.author: Brendan Carlos
reviews.text: We originally called Sam's landscaping for help with drainage. When Jim came to my house instead of him just asking for my lot size like everyone else, he walked the entire property with me and was able to identify all the problem drainage areas. He was incredibly fair with his price compared to the competition and even helped us move large rocks, escavate un-even ground, and put down approximately 11 yards of mulch. Just like Jim, his crew was super professional and extremely driven. These guys came, worked hard, and left without issue. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again or recommend them to my friends family.

reviews.author: Matt Kulper
reviews.text: We used Sam’s to do bush and shrub trimming, weed removable and paver sand placement. Process took a little over a day and his crew were on it every step of the way. Even during inclement weather, Jim was responsive and accommodating for the next available opportunity to complete the work. Will certainly be using Sam’s again.

reviews.author: Hassan Zahid
reviews.text: On time, started the work right away. Fair pricing. Left the property cleaner then they received it. Appreciate it!!

reviews.author: George Novalany
reviews.text: They did an excellent job of leaf removal and disposal. I have many trees and bushes and the lawn and flower beds were thoroughly cleaned not only of the leaves but of dead branches that had fallen from my oak trees. Very happy with the results.

reviews.author: Sage Noto
reviews.text: Sam’s Landscaping team cleaned my front yard, shaped the bushes, extracted old dead plants and flowers and laid new mulch. They were friendly and did an amazing job!

reviews.author: Nick Basso
reviews.text: Sam's Landscaping did a terrific job for us with a fall cleanup. We're very pleased with their service and we will be using them again in the spring!

reviews.author: Matthew Tirella
reviews.text: During March of 2022, we had drainage issues in our backyard that caused rainwater to pool. We called Sam’s Landscaping for a quote and the owner, Jim, promptly responded and came over to assess our situation and provide the quote in person. The work involved digging up the backyard and patio, installing a drainage system and resetting the patio when completed. Jim honored the quote and was responsive throughout the entire process. His team worked diligently and completed the project in about 4 days. When we requested an add-on the scope of work to tie our gutter into the new drainage system, he came onsite to discuss and was very amenable in working out a solution with us. Towards the end of the project we noted that some of the items agreed upon in the scope were not completed and when we pointed them out, he promptly sent his team back to complete the work to our specifications. At the end of the project we requested to do a walkthrough with Jim and he gladly came onsite, where we tested the drainage system by using a hose at the drainage and gutter sites with no issues. Additionally his team put down grass seed and slowly but surely the grass is growing back. Overall we appreciated the quick quote, continuous contact, the flexibility when we requested an add-on to the scope, and working on our job until we were satisfied. We highly recommend Sam’s Landscaping and had a very positive experience working with Jim.

reviews.author: Debbie Shapiro
reviews.text: We are very happy with your service.and staff! Sam’s Landscaping has taken care of our landscaping and lawn needs for the last 4 years. We would recommend them in a heartbeat! Their prices are fair and the quality of their work is fantastic. We, also, appreciate how quickly Jim helped us to get Rick’s mother’s home ready to be sold. Jim and his staff worked so hard to enhance her landscaping. We KNOW that was a big part of why the house sold quickly. Lastly, we feel grateful that you offered a service of snow removal. It’s been comforting to know that we don’t have to shovel. Sam’s Landscaping has our unreserved recommendation.

reviews.author: Rosann Blasi
reviews.text: For the past 2 years, my husband has been suffering from a terminal illness and has been unable to maintain our property . It was so overwhelming and overgrown! I called Sam's Landscaping, he agreed to take on the job and what a beautiful job they did! Everyone has commented on how nice everything looks. I'm so happy! Don't hesitate to call him for your needs, you won't be disappointed. Rosann B.

reviews.author: Natasha Sepe
reviews.text: Sam’s was quick to respond and quick to stop by! My yard really needed a spring cleanup and they were speedy, reasonable and flexible. Our yard looks great and ready for spring planting!

reviews.author: Christine Gee
reviews.text: Recently hired Sam's Landscaping for large yard clean up, routine maintenance, and some landscaping work. Everything done well, on time, and reasonably priced. And, the ability to always reach the owner and get personalized service is a big plus!

reviews.author: jeanine duke
reviews.text: Company does amazing work. I have seen it for myself at our friends home & Jim being the true wonderful person who seems to still actually really care about people & not just the mighty (not so mighty anymore) $$ has helped us out a few times on our front area due to my husband being ill. I truly feel there should be more people out there in the World like Jim & I Pray for continued growth for his Company & Team.

reviews.author: Kenneth Wood
reviews.text: Very professional work on our new patio. Hard working crew who knew what they were doing. Patio came out exactly like we wanted. Highly recommend Sam's Landscaping.

reviews.author: Kassandra D
reviews.text: Our lawn mower stopped working and we were really struggling to keep up our lawn. It got pretty out of hand! These guys came like angels and made our lawn beautiful. I am so appreciative (and so are our neighbors!)

reviews.author: Brett Masarky
reviews.text: Jim & Everyone at Sam's Landscaping were great. We hired Sam's for a fairly large patio demo and installation of new hardscaping. The whole process from start to finish was top notch and we love the end result!

reviews.author: Jani Rimpici
reviews.text: Sam’s landscaping did a great job with sprucing up my front lawn including weeding, pruning and mulching. Jim was very responsive to my texts, answered my questions and worked with me to get the job done within my time frame. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Maryna Malashevich
reviews.text: Contracted Sam’s landscaping to build a stackable slate wall. Very pleased with his work and how place was left clean afterwards. Communication is easy and fast And he is more affordable than others in my case.

reviews.author: Steve Ruiz
reviews.text: Sam’s crew did an awesome job!!! Pricing was very reasonable and the guys that came were very courteous and polite and worked very quickly. A job that other landscapers told me would take an entire day took less than 2 hours. It pays to have the proper machinery. These guys not only do landscaping but also a handful of other stuff. I highly recommend them to anyone looking to do any work on their home or yard.

reviews.author: Traci Monroe
reviews.text: This is my first year using a Landscaper for lawn maintenance. Sam’s Landscaping provides excellent service. They are very professional and show care for your property. When I needed some additional work completed, they did it without hesitation. I definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Stephen Tarver
reviews.text: Sam’s Landscaping is hands down the best. Hired them to remove the leaves from my front and rear yard. Not a leaf in site, when I arrived home from work. I was very happy, with there services. Far exceeded my expectations. Will hire them for future work and would refer them to anyone needing there services.

reviews.author: Waring Webb
reviews.text: Filled my shed bases with dirt and stone in a prompt fashion. Bases look great. Cleaned up site well.

reviews.author: Jess (Jessy)
reviews.text: Jim & his guys were great!- very knowledgeable, on time & efficent. Project of re-doing patio was finishing within 3 days along with landscaping of the backyard. Left my backyard brand new!

reviews.author: Frank Terista
reviews.text: Had sam’s do clean up, trimmed trees and bushes. Took out weeds in the garden and planted some new bushes. Price was reasonable and work was done in the day. I would use sam’s for future work.

reviews.author: Alex Washington
reviews.text: I called for leaf removal they did a great job. Their service was prompt and professional. I will need some work done in the spring. They are definitely number one on my list.

reviews.author: Glenn Hayes
reviews.text: I used Sam’s Landscaping to remove sand and a rock border from where above ground pool used to be and to re-grade to make even with existing lawn and add topsoil and re-seed. They did what they said they would do, when they said they would do it, at the price that was quoted. They performed the job very professionally, cleaned up thoroughly and even added some more seed where their equipment had to be rolled over another part of the lawn. I found them easy to business with.

reviews.author: David G
reviews.text: This was the second project we had Jim's team do this year, we were very happy with both. This time they refreshed our beds in the front with new rocks, everything looks great. We definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Ariel Gonzalez
reviews.text: Paver walkway was beautifully installed. They took their time and completed the job in 1 day. Easy scheduling and quick to respond

reviews.author: John Willner
reviews.text: Great job again! Have had Sam's do landscaping, pavers and fence repair. Projects that I couldn't do or would take me forever they get done in no time and looks fantastic! Professional, courteous, just the best! Thanks again.

reviews.author: D Silva
reviews.text: Very happy with the work done in my yard. Professional, quick & efficient. Would definitely recommend for any landscaping necessities!

reviews.author: Elena Kim
reviews.text: Responsive and on time. His team is a hardoworking people. The quality is good. We did stone patio and garden path. Happy with the results.

reviews.author: Mary Ann Esmerado
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Sam listens and delivers! Workers hard working, nest and nice. Very happy with the completed work.

reviews.author: santimobeach
reviews.text: Aerated my lawn. Great job finished fast. Upon inspection saw what a fine job they did. Very reasonable price. Will use for other services.

reviews.author: Volodymyr Gogol
reviews.text: They got to work even sooner than they said they'd be able to, were very efficient with the work, and did a beautiful job while accomodating various requests. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Taylor Calise
reviews.text: Sam's Landscaping did a great job with mowing the lawn and trimming the hedges around my house. They also have great customer service!

reviews.author: Jean-Paul Richer
reviews.text: Sam’s did a stellar job on my spring cleanup and mulching. Looking forward to more service by them on my property in the future.

reviews.author: Michael Stroppa
reviews.text: Pleased with the work! Fast, professional and the work was complete when they said it would be. Can’t ask for much more than that!

reviews.author: Bereket Assefa
reviews.text: The crew were on time. They did good job cleaning and straightening fixing and broken trees they left the yard spotless

reviews.author: Joe Rawls
reviews.text: The communication and service were outstanding. Extremely fair pricing. I would definitely use again and recommend others give them a try.

reviews.author: Josie Haselum
reviews.text: Great working with Sam’s landscaping on our patio and drainage project, great communication and all work completed in agreed timeframe - super quality work would recommend!!

reviews.author: William King
reviews.text: Sam's Landscaping Review We are extremely pleased with the quality of work from Sam's Landscaping. Jim made several suggestions which enhanced the look of the landscaping we were looking for around the front and side of our house. They are competitively priced and the workmanship was first-rate. The workers were friendly and easy to work with and did whatever we asked to ensure we were satisfied with the completed work. In closing, we would recommend Sam's Landscaping for any of your landscaping needs.
